name: Hamamatsu Photonics A/S (formerly NKT Photonics)
description: Hamamatsu Photonics A/S — renamed from NKT Photonics A/S on 25 June 2026 following Hamamatsu Photonics' 2024 acquisition, and now the Lasers & Fibers Business Unit of the Hamamatsu Photonics Group — is a Danish photonics manufacturer headquartered in Birkerod, producing fiber lasers, photonic crystal fibers, supercontinuum sources, and single-frequency lasers used by quantum and photonics labs worldwide. The company has an explicit Quantum & Nano Technology product line — its Koheras low-noise lasers are widely deployed in cold-atom systems and as pumps for single-photon sources. It is the only Danish company in the European Quantum Flagship and is also a member of the European Quantum Industry Consortium, the Quantum Economic Development Consortium, and the Danish Quantum Community board.

news.title: NKT Photonics A/S formally renamed Hamamatsu Photonics A/S, effective June 25, 2026
news.excerpt: NKT Photonics A/S was officially renamed Hamamatsu Photonics A/S effective June 25, 2026, formalising its integration into the Hamamatsu Photonics Group following the 2024 acquisition. Operations, product portfolio, and customer relationships remain unchanged.
